---- MODULE ZkV3_7_0 ----
EXTENDS ZkV3_7_0Defs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgSeqL == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
LOCAL AgNatL == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction
LOCAL AgFinL == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

(* ============ basic sets and abbreviations ============ *)

AgZxS == Nat \X Nat

AgTxnS == [zxid: AgZxS, value: Value, ackSid: SUBSET Server, epoch: Nat]

AgInL(z, v, L) == \E p \in L : z[1] = p.zxid[1] /\ z[2] = p.zxid[2] /\ v = p.data

AgTxnOkIn(L) == { t \in AgTxnS : AgInL(t.zxid, t.value, L) }

AgOkTxn == AgTxnOkIn(proposalMsgsLog)

AgSrt(h) == \A a, b \in 1..Len(h) : a < b => ZxidCompare(h[b].zxid, h[a].zxid)

AgMsgOkIn(L) ==
       [mtype: {FOLLOWERINFO, LEADERINFO, NEWLEADER, ACKLD, UPTODATE, ACK, COMMIT, DIFF},
        mzxid: AgZxS]
  \cup [mtype: {ACKEPOCH}, mzxid: AgZxS, mepoch: Int]
  \cup [mtype: {TRUNC},    mtruncZxid: AgZxS]
  \cup { m \in [mtype: {SNAP}, msnapZxid: AgZxS, msnapshot: Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))] : AgSrt(m.msnapshot) }
  \cup { m \in [mtype: {PROPOSAL}, mzxid: AgZxS, mdata: Value] : AgInL(m.mzxid, m.mdata, L) }

AgOkMsg == AgMsgOkIn(proposalMsgsLog)

AgPos == [index: Nat, zxid: AgZxS]

AgSyncSIn(L) == [notCommitted: Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L)), committed: Seq(AgZxS)]

AgSyncS == AgSyncSIn(proposalMsgsLog)

AgL2F == {LEADERINFO, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP, NEWLEADER, PROPOSAL, COMMIT, UPTODATE}

AgF2L == {FOLLOWERINFO, ACKEPOCH, ACK, ACKLD}

AgHasIn(s, v, T) == \E k \in 1..Len(msgs[s][v]) : msgs[s][v][k].mtype \in T

AgCInfo == [sid: Server \cup {NullPoint}, syncMode: {NONE, DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP}, nlRcv: BOOLEAN]

AgConn == [sid: Server, connected: BOOLEAN]

AgElec == [sid: Server, peerLastZxid: Int \X Int, inQuorum: BOOLEAN]

AgHas(s, v, ty) == \E k \in 1..Len(msgs[s][v]) : msgs[s][v][k].mtype = ty

AgSids(S) == { x.sid : x \in S }

AgQC(i) == i \in AgSids(connecting[i]) /\ IsQuorum(AgSids(connecting[i]))

AgCat(s) == history[s] \o packetsSync[s].notCommitted

(* ============ generic sequence lemmas ============ *)

LEMMA AgSeqMono == ASSUME NEW S, NEW T, S \subseteq T, NEW s \in Seq(S)
                   PROVE  s \in Seq(T)
  BY AgSeqL!SeqMonotonic

LEMMA AgAppend == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S
                  PROVE  /\ Append(s,e) \in Seq(S)
                         /\ Len(Append(s,e)) = Len(s) + 1
                         /\ \A k \in 1..Len(s) : Append(s,e)[k] = s[k]
                         /\ Append(s,e)[Len(s)+1] = e
  BY AgSeqL!AppendProperties

LEMMA AgConcat == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW t \in Seq(S)
                  PROVE  /\ s \o t \in Seq(S)
                         /\ Len(s \o t) = Len(s) + Len(t)
                         /\ \A k \in 1..Len(s)+Len(t) :
                               (s \o t)[k] = IF k <= Len(s) THEN s[k] ELSE t[k - Len(s)]
  BY AgSeqL!ConcatProperties

LEMMA AgTailP == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), s # << >>
                 PROVE  /\ Tail(s) \in Seq(S)
                        /\ Len(Tail(s)) = Len(s) - 1
                        /\ \A k \in 1..Len(s)-1 : Tail(s)[k] = s[k+1]
  BY AgSeqL!HeadTailProperties

LEMMA AgLenP == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S)
                PROVE  /\ Len(s) \in Nat
                       /\ DOMAIN s = 1..Len(s)
                       /\ \A k \in 1..Len(s) : s[k] \in S
  BY AgSeqL!LenProperties, AgSeqL!ElementOfSeq

LEMMA AgEmptyP == ASSUME NEW S
                  PROVE  /\ << >> \in Seq(S)
                         /\ Len(<< >>) = 0
                         /\ \A s \in Seq(S) : (s # << >>) => Len(s) \in Nat \ {0}
  BY AgSeqL!EmptySeq

LEMMA AgHeadIn == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), s # << >>
                  PROVE  s[1] \in S /\ Len(s) >= 1
  BY AgSeqL!EmptySeq, AgSeqL!ElementOfSeq

LEMMA AgSubSeqP == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW n \in 0..Len(s)
                   PROVE  /\ SubSeq(s,1,n) \in Seq(S)
                          /\ Len(SubSeq(s,1,n)) = n
                          /\ \A k \in 1..n : SubSeq(s,1,n)[k] = s[k]
  <1>1. \A k \in 1..n : s[k] \in S
    BY AgLenP
  <1>2. /\ SubSeq(s,1,n) \in Seq(S)
        /\ Len(SubSeq(s,1,n)) = IF 1 <= n THEN n-1+1 ELSE 0
        /\ \A k \in 1..n-1+1 : SubSeq(s,1,n)[k] = s[1+k-1]
    <2>1. n \in Int /\ 1 \in Int
      BY AgLenP
    <2>2. QED BY <2>1, <1>1, AgSeqL!SubSeqProperties
  <1>3. QED BY <1>2, AgLenP

LEMMA AgAppLen == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW e
                  PROVE  Len(Append(s,e)) = Len(s) + 1
<1>1. s \in Seq(S \cup {e})
  BY AgSeqMono
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, AgAppend

LEMMA AgConcatLen == ASSUME NEW S, NEW T, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW t \in Seq(T)
                     PROVE  Len(s \o t) = Len(s) + Len(t)
<1>1. s \in Seq(S \cup T) /\ t \in Seq(S \cup T)
  BY AgSeqMono
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, AgConcat

LEMMA AgSrtUniq == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), AgSrt(h),
                          \A k \in 1..Len(h) : h[k].zxid \in Int \X Int,
                          NEW a \in 1..Len(h), NEW b \in 1..Len(h), NEW z,
                          TxnZxidEqual(h[a], z), TxnZxidEqual(h[b], z)
                   PROVE  a = b
  BY DEF AgSrt, ZxidCompare, TxnZxidEqual

LEMMA AgExcSeq == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW n \in 1..Len(s), NEW e \in S
                  PROVE  /\ [s EXCEPT ![n] = e] \in Seq(S)
                         /\ Len([s EXCEPT ![n] = e]) = Len(s)
  BY AgSeqL!ExceptSeq

LEMMA AgMkSeq == ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW e(_), NEW S, \A k \in 1..n : e(k) \in S
                 PROVE  /\ [k \in 1..n |-> e(k)] \in Seq(S)
                        /\ Len([k \in 1..n |-> e(k)]) = n
  <1>1. [k \in 1..n |-> e(k)] \in Seq(S)
    BY AgSeqL!IsASeq
  <1>2. QED BY <1>1, AgLenP

(* ============ message shape lemmas ============ *)

LEMMA AgMsgZx == ASSUME NEW m \in AgOkMsg,
                        m.mtype \in {FOLLOWERINFO, LEADERINFO, NEWLEADER, ACKLD, UPTODATE,
                                     ACK, COMMIT, DIFF, ACKEPOCH, PROPOSAL}
                 PROVE  m.mzxid \in AgZxS
  BY DEF AgOkMsg, AgMsgOkIn, FOLLOWERINFO, LEADERINFO, NEWLEADER, ACKLD, UPTODATE, ACK,
         COMMIT, DIFF, ACKEPOCH, TRUNC, SNAP, PROPOSAL

LEMMA AgMsgTr == ASSUME NEW m \in AgOkMsg, m.mtype = TRUNC
                 PROVE  m.mtruncZxid \in AgZxS
  BY DEF AgOkMsg, AgMsgOkIn, FOLLOWERINFO, LEADERINFO, NEWLEADER, ACKLD, UPTODATE, ACK,
         COMMIT, DIFF, ACKEPOCH, TRUNC, SNAP, PROPOSAL

LEMMA AgMsgSn == ASSUME NEW m \in AgOkMsg, m.mtype = SNAP
                 PROVE  /\ m.msnapZxid \in AgZxS
                        /\ m.msnapshot \in Seq(AgOkTxn)
                        /\ AgSrt(m.msnapshot)
  BY DEF AgOkMsg, AgOkTxn, AgMsgOkIn, FOLLOWERINFO, LEADERINFO, NEWLEADER, ACKLD, UPTODATE, ACK,
         COMMIT, DIFF, ACKEPOCH, TRUNC, SNAP, PROPOSAL

LEMMA AgMsgPr == ASSUME NEW m \in AgOkMsg, m.mtype = PROPOSAL
                 PROVE  /\ m.mzxid \in AgZxS
                        /\ m.mdata \in Value
                        /\ AgInL(m.mzxid, m.mdata, proposalMsgsLog)
  BY DEF AgOkMsg, AgMsgOkIn, FOLLOWERINFO, LEADERINFO, NEWLEADER, ACKLD, UPTODATE, ACK,
         COMMIT, DIFF, ACKEPOCH, TRUNC, SNAP, PROPOSAL



(* ============ finite-set bridge lemmas ============ *)

LEMMA AgFinBr == /\ \A S : AgFinL!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
                 /\ \A S : AgFinL!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF AgFinL!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet, AgFinL!Cardinality, Cardinality

LEMMA AgFinInt == ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
                  PROVE  IsFiniteSet(a..b)
  BY AgFinL!FS_Interval, AgFinBr

LEMMA AgFinSub == ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T, T \subseteq S
                  PROVE  IsFiniteSet(T)
  BY AgFinL!FS_Subset, AgFinBr

LEMMA AgFinCT == ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S)
                 PROVE  Cardinality(S) \in Nat
  BY AgFinL!FS_CardinalityType, AgFinBr

LEMMA AgFinEmp == /\ IsFiniteSet({})
                  /\ Cardinality({}) = 0
                  /\ \A S : IsFiniteSet(S) => (Cardinality(S) = 0 <=> S = {})
  BY AgFinL!FS_EmptySet, AgFinBr

LEMMA AgFinSing == \A x : IsFiniteSet({x}) /\ Cardinality({x}) = 1
  BY AgFinL!FS_Singleton, AgFinBr

(* ============ index-computation lemmas ============ *)

LEMMA AgMinNat == ASSUME NEW G, G \subseteq Nat, G # {}
                  PROVE  \E k \in G : \A m \in G : k <= m
<1> DEFINE P(n) == n \in G
<1>1. \E n \in Nat : P(n)
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. PICK n \in Nat : P(n)
  BY <1>1
<1>3. \E m \in Nat : P(m) /\ \A k \in 0..m-1 : ~ P(k)
  <2> HIDE DEF P
  <2> QED BY <1>2, AgNatL!SmallestNatural
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>3

LEMMA AgZTIInt == ASSUME NEW S, NEW his \in Seq(S), NEW z
                  PROVE  ZxidToIndex(his, z) \in Int
<1>n. Len(his) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1> DEFINE M == {k \in 1..Len(his) : TxnZxidEqual(his[k], z)}
<1>f. IsFiniteSet(M) /\ Cardinality(M) \in Nat
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(1..Len(his))
    BY <1>n, AgFinInt
  <2>2. M \in SUBSET (1..Len(his))
    OBVIOUS
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, AgFinSub, AgFinCT
<1>h. ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) \in Int
  <2>1. ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) =
           CASE Cardinality(M) = 0 -> Len(his) + 1
           []   Cardinality(M) = 1 -> CHOOSE k \in M : TRUE
           []   OTHER -> -1
    BY DEF ZxidToIndexHepler
  <2>2. CASE Cardinality(M) = 0
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>n
  <2>3. CASE Cardinality(M) = 1
    <3>1. M # {}
      BY <2>3, <1>f, AgFinEmp
    <3>2. (CHOOSE k \in M : TRUE) \in M
      BY <3>1
    <3>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>3, <3>2, <1>n
  <2>4. CASE Cardinality(M) # 0 /\ Cardinality(M) # 1
    BY <2>1, <2>4
  <2>5. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4
<1> QED
  BY <1>h, <1>n DEF ZxidToIndex

LEMMA AgZTIUniq ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW his \in Seq(S), NEW z,
         \A a, b \in 1..Len(his) : TxnZxidEqual(his[a], z) /\ TxnZxidEqual(his[b], z) => a = b
  PROVE  /\ ZxidToIndex(his, z) \in 0..(Len(his)+1)
         /\ ( /\ ~ZxidEqual(z, <<0,0>>)
              /\ \E k \in 1..Len(his) : TxnZxidEqual(his[k], z) )
               => ZxidToIndex(his, z) \in 1..Len(his)
<1>n. Len(his) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1> DEFINE M == {k \in 1..Len(his) : TxnZxidEqual(his[k], z)}
<1>f. IsFiniteSet(M)
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(1..Len(his))
    BY <1>n, AgFinInt
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1, AgFinSub
<1>e. M # {} => ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) \in 1..Len(his)
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME M # {} PROVE ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) \in 1..Len(his)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. PICK k0 \in M : TRUE
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. M = {k0}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>3. Cardinality(M) = 1
    BY <2>2, AgFinSing
  <2>4. ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) = CHOOSE k \in M : TRUE
    BY <2>3 DEF ZxidToIndexHepler
  <2>5. (CHOOSE k \in M : TRUE) \in M
    BY <2>1
  <2>6. QED BY <2>4, <2>5
<1>z. M = {} => ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) = Len(his) + 1
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME M = {} PROVE ZxidToIndexHepler(his, z, 1, FALSE) = Len(his) + 1
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. Cardinality(M) = 0
    BY AgFinEmp
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1 DEF ZxidToIndexHepler
<1> QED
  BY <1>e, <1>z, <1>n DEF ZxidToIndex

LEMMA AgMinSet == ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, NEW G, G \subseteq 1..n, G # {}
                  PROVE  (CHOOSE k \in G : \A m \in G : k <= m) \in G
<1>1. G \subseteq Nat
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. \E k \in G : \A m \in G : k <= m
  BY <1>1, AgMinNat
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2

LEMMA AgIdxH == ASSUME NEW S, NEW his \in Seq(S), NEW z
                PROVE  IndexOfZxidHelper(his, z, 1, Len(his)) \in 0..Len(his)
<1>n. Len(his) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1> DEFINE G == {k \in 1..Len(his) : ZxidCompare(his[k].zxid, z)}
<1>g. G \subseteq 1..Len(his)
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. IndexOfZxidHelper(his, z, 1, Len(his)) =
         IF G = {} THEN Len(his)
                   ELSE (CHOOSE k \in G : \A m \in G : k <= m) - 1
  BY DEF IndexOfZxidHelper
<1>2. CASE G = {}
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>n
<1>3. CASE G # {}
  <2> DEFINE kk == CHOOSE k \in G : \A m \in G : k <= m
  <2>1. kk \in G
    BY <1>n, <1>g, <1>3, AgMinSet
  <2>2. kk \in 1..Len(his)
    BY <2>1, <1>g
  <2>3. kk - 1 \in 0..Len(his)
    BY <2>2, <1>n
  <2>4. IndexOfZxidHelper(his, z, 1, Len(his)) = kk - 1
    BY <1>1, <1>3
  <2>5. QED
    BY <2>3, <2>4
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA AgIOZ == ASSUME NEW S, NEW his \in Seq(S), NEW z,
                      ZxidToIndex(his, z) \in 0..(Len(his)+1)
               PROVE  IndexOfZxid(his, z) \in 0..Len(his)
<1>n. Len(his) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>h. IndexOfZxidHelper(his, z, 1, Len(his)) \in 0..Len(his)
  BY AgIdxH
<1>1. CASE Len(his) = 0
  BY <1>1 DEF IndexOfZxid
<1>2. CASE Len(his) # 0
  BY <1>2, <1>h, <1>n DEF IndexOfZxid
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2


(* ============ monotonicity in the proposal log ============ *)

LEMMA AgTxnMono == ASSUME NEW L1, NEW L2, L1 \subseteq L2
                   PROVE  AgTxnOkIn(L1) \subseteq AgTxnOkIn(L2)
  BY DEF AgTxnOkIn, AgInL

LEMMA AgMsgMono == ASSUME NEW L1, NEW L2, L1 \subseteq L2
                   PROVE  AgMsgOkIn(L1) \subseteq AgMsgOkIn(L2)
<1>1. AgTxnOkIn(L1) \subseteq AgTxnOkIn(L2)
  BY AgTxnMono
<1>2. Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L1)) \subseteq Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L2))
  BY <1>1, AgSeqMono
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2 DEF AgMsgOkIn, AgInL

LEMMA AgSyncMono == ASSUME NEW L1, NEW L2, L1 \subseteq L2
                    PROVE  AgSyncSIn(L1) \subseteq AgSyncSIn(L2)
<1>1. Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L1)) \subseteq Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L2))
  BY AgTxnMono, AgSeqMono
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1 DEF AgSyncSIn

(* ============ leader-set update lemmas ============ *)

LEMMA AgZxInt == ASSUME NEW z \in AgZxS PROVE z \in Int \X Int
  BY DEF AgZxS

LEMMA AgRemEl == ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq AgElec, NEW sid
                 PROVE  RemoveElecting(S, sid) \subseteq AgElec
<1>1. CASE sid \notin {s.sid : s \in S}
  BY <1>1 DEF RemoveElecting
<1>2. CASE sid \in {s.sid : s \in S}
  <2>1. PICK inf \in S : inf.sid = sid
    BY <1>2
  <2>2. (CHOOSE s \in S : s.sid = sid) \in S
    BY <2>1
  <2>3. sid \in Server
    BY <2>1 DEF AgElec
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>2, <2>3 DEF RemoveElecting, AgElec
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgRemCo == ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq AgConn, NEW sid
                 PROVE  RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv(S, sid) \subseteq AgConn
<1>1. CASE sid \notin {s.sid : s \in S}
  BY <1>1 DEF RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv
<1>2. CASE sid \in {s.sid : s \in S}
  <2>1. PICK inf \in S : inf.sid = sid
    BY <1>2
  <2>2. (CHOOSE s \in S : s.sid = sid) \in S
    BY <2>1
  <2>3. sid \in Server
    BY <2>1 DEF AgConn
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>2, <2>2, <2>3 DEF RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv, AgConn
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgUpdCo == ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq AgConn, NEW sid \in Server
                 PROVE  UpdateConnectingOrAckldRecv(S, sid) \subseteq AgConn
<1>1. CASE sid \in {s.sid : s \in S}
  <2>1. PICK inf \in S : inf.sid = sid
    BY <1>1
  <2>2. (CHOOSE info \in S : info.sid = sid) \in S
    BY <2>1
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>2 DEF UpdateConnectingOrAckldRecv, AgConn
<1>2. CASE sid \notin {s.sid : s \in S}
  BY <1>2 DEF UpdateConnectingOrAckldRecv, AgConn
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgUpdEl == ASSUME NEW S, S \subseteq AgElec, NEW sid \in Server,
                        NEW z \in Int \X Int, NEW q \in BOOLEAN
                 PROVE  UpdateElecting(S, sid, z, q) \subseteq AgElec
<1>1. CASE sid \in {s.sid : s \in S}
  <2>1. PICK inf \in S : inf.sid = sid
    BY <1>1
  <2>2. (CHOOSE info \in S : info.sid = sid) \in S
    BY <2>1
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>2 DEF UpdateElecting, AgElec
<1>2. CASE sid \notin {s.sid : s \in S}
  BY <1>2 DEF UpdateElecting, AgElec
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgRemElZ == ASSUME NEW S, NEW sid, NEW e, e \in RemoveElecting(S, sid)
                  PROVE  e \in S \/ (e.sid = sid /\ e.peerLastZxid = <<-1,-1>>)
  BY DEF RemoveElecting

LEMMA AgExcEl == ASSUME NEW f \in [Server -> SUBSET AgElec], NEW x, NEW sid
                 PROVE  [f EXCEPT ![x] = RemoveElecting(f[x], sid)] \in [Server -> SUBSET AgElec]
<1>1. CASE x \in Server
  BY <1>1, AgRemEl
<1>2. CASE x \notin Server
  <2>1. [f EXCEPT ![x] = RemoveElecting(f[x], sid)] = f
    BY <1>2
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgExcCo == ASSUME NEW f \in [Server -> SUBSET AgConn], NEW x, NEW sid
                 PROVE  [f EXCEPT ![x] = RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv(f[x], sid)]
                            \in [Server -> SUBSET AgConn]
<1>1. CASE x \in Server
  BY <1>1, AgRemCo
<1>2. CASE x \notin Server
  <2>1. [f EXCEPT ![x] = RemoveConnectingOrAckldRecv(f[x], sid)] = f
    BY <1>2
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

(* ============ history-transforming helpers ============ *)

LEMMA AgMinPair == ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
                   PROVE  Minimum({a,b}) \in {a,b}
<1>1. \E n \in {a,b} : \A m \in {a,b} : n <= m
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF Minimum

LEMMA AgInitAck == ASSUME NEW L, NEW h \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L)), NEW src \in Server
                   PROVE  /\ InitAcksidInTxns(h, src) \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))
                          /\ Len(InitAcksidInTxns(h, src)) = Len(h)
                          /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h) : InitAcksidInTxns(h, src)[k].zxid = h[k].zxid
<1>1. \A k \in 1..Len(h) : h[k] \in AgTxnOkIn(L)
  BY AgLenP
<1>2. \A k \in 1..Len(h) :
         [ zxid |-> h[k].zxid, value |-> h[k].value, ackSid |-> {src}, epoch |-> h[k].epoch ]
            \in AgTxnOkIn(L)
  BY <1>1 DEF AgTxnOkIn, AgTxnS, AgInL
<1>3. Len(h) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, AgMkSeq DEF InitAcksidInTxns

LEMMA AgUpdAckOk == ASSUME NEW L, NEW h \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L)), NEW idx \in Int, NEW tgt \in Server
                    PROVE  /\ UpdateAckSid(h, idx, tgt) \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))
                           /\ Len(UpdateAckSid(h, idx, tgt)) = Len(h)
                           /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h) : UpdateAckSid(h, idx, tgt)[k].zxid = h[k].zxid
<1>n. Len(h) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>1. CASE Len(h) = 0 \/ idx = 0
  BY <1>1 DEF UpdateAckSid
<1>2. CASE ~(Len(h) = 0 \/ idx = 0)
  <2>m. Minimum({Len(h), idx}) \in Int
    BY <1>n, AgMinPair
  <2>1. \A k \in 1..Len(h) : h[k] \in AgTxnOkIn(L)
    BY AgLenP
  <2>2. \A k \in 1..Len(h) :
           [ zxid |-> h[k].zxid, value |-> h[k].value,
             ackSid |-> IF tgt \in h[k].ackSid THEN h[k].ackSid ELSE h[k].ackSid \union {tgt},
             epoch |-> h[k].epoch ] \in AgTxnOkIn(L)
    BY <2>1 DEF AgTxnOkIn, AgTxnS, AgInL
  <2>3. \A k \in 1..Len(h) :
           (IF k <= Minimum({Len(h), idx}) - 1 + 1
            THEN [ zxid |-> h[k].zxid, value |-> h[k].value,
                   ackSid |-> IF tgt \in h[k].ackSid THEN h[k].ackSid ELSE h[k].ackSid \union {tgt},
                   epoch |-> h[k].epoch ]
            ELSE h[k]) \in AgTxnOkIn(L)
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>m
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>2, <1>n, <2>3, AgMkSeq DEF UpdateAckSid, UpdateAckSidHelper
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgTruncOk == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW n \in Int, n <= Len(h)
                   PROVE  /\ TruncateLog(h, n) \in Seq(S)
                          /\ Len(TruncateLog(h, n)) = IF n <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE n
<1>1. CASE n <= 0
  BY <1>1, AgEmptyP DEF TruncateLog
<1>2. CASE ~(n <= 0)
  <2>1. n \in 0..Len(h)
    BY <1>2, AgLenP
  <2>2. QED BY <1>2, <2>1, AgSubSeqP DEF TruncateLog
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

(* ============ sortedness helpers ============ *)

LEMMA AgZxTrans == ASSUME NEW x \in Int \X Int, NEW y \in Int \X Int, NEW z \in Int \X Int,
                          ZxidCompare(x, y), ZxidCompare(y, z)
                   PROVE  ZxidCompare(x, z)
  BY DEF ZxidCompare

LEMMA AgSrtSame == ASSUME NEW S, NEW T, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW g \in Seq(T),
                          Len(g) = Len(h), \A k \in 1..Len(h) : g[k].zxid = h[k].zxid,
                          AgSrt(h)
                   PROVE  AgSrt(g)
  BY DEF AgSrt

LEMMA AgSrtTrunc == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), AgSrt(h), NEW n \in Int, n <= Len(h)
                    PROVE  AgSrt(TruncateLog(h, n))
<1>1. CASE n <= 0
  BY <1>1, AgEmptyP DEF TruncateLog, AgSrt
<1>2. CASE ~(n <= 0)
  <2>1. n \in 0..Len(h)
    BY <1>2, AgLenP
  <2>2. /\ SubSeq(h,1,n) \in Seq(S)
        /\ Len(SubSeq(h,1,n)) = n
        /\ \A k \in 1..n : SubSeq(h,1,n)[k] = h[k]
    BY <2>1, AgSubSeqP
  <2>3. QED BY <2>2, <1>2, <2>1, AgLenP DEF TruncateLog, AgSrt
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgSrtCatL == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW t \in Seq(S), AgSrt(h \o t)
                   PROVE  AgSrt(h)
<1>1. /\ Len(h \o t) = Len(h) + Len(t)
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t) : (h \o t)[k] = IF k <= Len(h) THEN h[k] ELSE t[k - Len(h)]
  BY AgConcat
<1>2. Len(h) \in Nat /\ Len(t) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF AgSrt

LEMMA AgSrtApp == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), AgSrt(h), NEW e,
                         \A k \in 1..Len(h) : h[k].zxid \in Int \X Int,
                         e.zxid \in Int \X Int,
                         Len(h) > 0 => ZxidCompare(e.zxid, h[Len(h)].zxid)
                  PROVE  AgSrt(Append(h, e))
<1>n. Len(h) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>1. h \in Seq(S \cup {e}) /\ e \in S \cup {e}
  BY AgSeqMono
<1>2. /\ Len(Append(h,e)) = Len(h) + 1
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h) : Append(h,e)[k] = h[k]
      /\ Append(h,e)[Len(h)+1] = e
  BY <1>1, AgAppend
<1>3. \A a, b \in 1..Len(h)+1 :
         a < b => ZxidCompare(Append(h,e)[b].zxid, Append(h,e)[a].zxid)
  <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW a \in 1..Len(h)+1, NEW b \in 1..Len(h)+1, a < b
      PROVE  ZxidCompare(Append(h,e)[b].zxid, Append(h,e)[a].zxid)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>0. a \in 1..Len(h)
    BY <1>n
  <2>1. CASE b <= Len(h)
    <3>1. b \in 1..Len(h)
      BY <2>1, <1>n
    <3>2. ZxidCompare(h[b].zxid, h[a].zxid)
      BY <3>1, <2>0 DEF AgSrt
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <2>0, <3>2, <1>2
  <2>2. CASE ~(b <= Len(h))
    <3>0. b = Len(h) + 1
      BY <2>2, <1>n
    <3>1. CASE a = Len(h)
      BY <1>2, <3>0, <3>1, <1>n
    <3>2. CASE a # Len(h)
      <4>1. a < Len(h)
        BY <2>0, <3>2, <1>n
      <4>2. ZxidCompare(h[Len(h)].zxid, h[a].zxid)
        BY <4>1, <2>0, <1>n DEF AgSrt
      <4>3. ZxidCompare(e.zxid, h[Len(h)].zxid)
        BY <4>1, <1>n
      <4>4. h[Len(h)].zxid \in Int \X Int /\ h[a].zxid \in Int \X Int
        BY <4>1, <2>0, <1>n
      <4>5. ZxidCompare(e.zxid, h[a].zxid)
        BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4, AgZxTrans
      <4>6. QED
        BY <4>5, <1>2, <3>0, <2>0, <1>n
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>3, <1>2 DEF AgSrt

LEMMA AgCatEmpty == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S) PROVE h \o << >> = h
  BY AgSeqL!ConcatEmptySeq

LEMMA AgCatAT == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW t \in Seq(S), t # << >>
                 PROVE  Append(h, t[1]) \o Tail(t) = h \o t
<1>n. Len(h) \in Nat /\ Len(t) \in Nat /\ Len(t) >= 1
  BY AgLenP, AgHeadIn
<1>1. /\ Append(h, t[1]) \in Seq(S)
      /\ Len(Append(h, t[1])) = Len(h) + 1
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h) : Append(h, t[1])[k] = h[k]
      /\ Append(h, t[1])[Len(h)+1] = t[1]
  BY AgHeadIn, AgAppend
<1>2. /\ Tail(t) \in Seq(S)
      /\ Len(Tail(t)) = Len(t) - 1
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(t)-1 : Tail(t)[k] = t[k+1]
  BY AgTailP
<1>3. /\ Append(h, t[1]) \o Tail(t) \in Seq(S)
      /\ Len(Append(h, t[1]) \o Tail(t)) = Len(h) + Len(t)
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t) :
            (Append(h, t[1]) \o Tail(t))[k] =
               IF k <= Len(h)+1 THEN Append(h, t[1])[k] ELSE Tail(t)[k - (Len(h)+1)]
  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgConcat, <1>n
<1>4. /\ h \o t \in Seq(S)
      /\ Len(h \o t) = Len(h) + Len(t)
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t) : (h \o t)[k] = IF k <= Len(h) THEN h[k] ELSE t[k - Len(h)]
  BY AgConcat
<1>5. \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t) : (Append(h, t[1]) \o Tail(t))[k] = (h \o t)[k]
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>n
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, AgSeqL!SeqEqual

LEMMA AgCatApp == ASSUME NEW S, NEW h \in Seq(S), NEW t \in Seq(S), NEW e
                  PROVE  h \o Append(t, e) = Append(h \o t, e)
<1>1. h \in Seq(S \cup {e}) /\ t \in Seq(S \cup {e}) /\ e \in S \cup {e}
  BY AgSeqMono
<1>n. Len(h) \in Nat /\ Len(t) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>2. /\ Append(t,e) \in Seq(S \cup {e})
      /\ Len(Append(t,e)) = Len(t) + 1
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(t) : Append(t,e)[k] = t[k]
      /\ Append(t,e)[Len(t)+1] = e
  BY <1>1, AgAppend
<1>3. /\ h \o t \in Seq(S \cup {e})
      /\ Len(h \o t) = Len(h) + Len(t)
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t) : (h \o t)[k] = IF k <= Len(h) THEN h[k] ELSE t[k - Len(h)]
  BY <1>1, AgConcat
<1>4. /\ Append(h \o t, e) \in Seq(S \cup {e})
      /\ Len(Append(h \o t, e)) = Len(h) + Len(t) + 1
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t) : Append(h \o t, e)[k] = (h \o t)[k]
      /\ Append(h \o t, e)[Len(h)+Len(t)+1] = e
  BY <1>1, <1>3, AgAppend
<1>5. /\ h \o Append(t,e) \in Seq(S \cup {e})
      /\ Len(h \o Append(t,e)) = Len(h) + Len(t) + 1
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t)+1 :
            (h \o Append(t,e))[k] = IF k <= Len(h) THEN h[k] ELSE Append(t,e)[k - Len(h)]
  BY <1>1, <1>2, AgConcat, <1>n
<1>6. \A k \in 1..Len(h)+Len(t)+1 : (h \o Append(t,e))[k] = Append(h \o t, e)[k]
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>n
<1>7. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, AgSeqL!SeqEqual

LEMMA AgNextZx == ASSUME NEW x \in Nat \X Nat, NEW y \in Nat \X Nat, IsNextZxid(x, y)
                  PROVE  ZxidCompare(y, x)
  BY DEF IsNextZxid, ZxidCompare

(* ============ shape of the sync-message action ============ *)

LEMMA AgIOZInt == ASSUME NEW S, NEW his \in Seq(S), NEW z
                  PROVE  IndexOfZxid(his, z) \in Int
<1>1. Len(his) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP
<1>2. ZxidToIndex(his, z) \in Int
  BY AgZTIInt
<1>3. IndexOfZxidHelper(his, z, 1, Len(his)) \in 0..Len(his)
  BY AgIdxH
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF IndexOfZxid

LEMMA AgSSMHist ==
  ASSUME NEW L, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, NEW lz, NEW li \in Int, NEW md,
         history \in [Server -> Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))],
         SendSyncMsgs(i, j, lz, li, md, FALSE)
  PROVE  /\ history' \in [Server -> Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))]
         /\ \A s \in Server : /\ Len(history'[s]) = Len(history[s])
                              /\ \A k \in 1..Len(history[s]) : history'[s][k].zxid = history[s][k].zxid
<1>1. history[i] \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))
  OBVIOUS
<1>2. /\ UpdateAckSid(history[i], li, j) \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))
      /\ Len(UpdateAckSid(history[i], li, j)) = Len(history[i])
      /\ \A k \in 1..Len(history[i]) : UpdateAckSid(history[i], li, j)[k].zxid = history[i][k].zxid
  BY <1>1, AgUpdAckOk
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2 DEF SendSyncMsgs

LEMMA AgSyncFHist ==
  ASSUME NEW L, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server, NEW pz,
         history \in [Server -> Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))],
         lastProcessed[i].index \in Int,
         lastCommitted[i].index \in Int,
         SyncFollower(i, j, pz, FALSE)
  PROVE  /\ history' \in [Server -> Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))]
         /\ \A s \in Server : /\ Len(history'[s]) = Len(history[s])
                              /\ \A k \in 1..Len(history[s]) : history'[s][k].zxid = history[s][k].zxid
<1>1. history[i] \in Seq(AgTxnOkIn(L))
  OBVIOUS
<1>n. Len(history[i]) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, AgLenP
<1>2. ZxidToIndex(history[i], pz) \in Int
  BY <1>1, AgZTIInt
<1>3. IndexOfZxid(history[i], pz) \in Int
  BY <1>1, AgIOZInt
<1>4. (IF zabState[i] = BROADCAST THEN lastCommitted[i].index ELSE Len(history[i])) \in Int
  BY <1>n
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>n, AgSSMHist DEF SyncFollower

LEMMA AgSSMMsgs == ASSUME NEW i, NEW j, NEW lz, NEW li, NEW md,
                          SendSyncMsgs(i, j, lz, li, md, FALSE)
                   PROVE  \E q : msgs' = [msgs EXCEPT ![i][j] = q]
  BY DEF SendSyncMsgs, SendPackets

LEMMA AgSyncFMsgs == ASSUME NEW i, NEW j, NEW pz, SyncFollower(i, j, pz, FALSE)
                     PROVE  \E q : msgs' = [msgs EXCEPT ![i][j] = q]
  BY AgSSMMsgs DEF SyncFollower

(* ============ the inductive invariant ============ *)

AgT1 == history        \in [Server -> Seq(AgOkTxn)]
AgT2 == packetsSync    \in [Server -> AgSyncS]
AgT3 == msgs           \in [Server -> [Server -> Seq(AgOkMsg)]]
AgT4 == initialHistory \in [Server -> Seq(AgTxnS)]
AgT5 == lastCommitted  \in [Server -> AgPos]
AgT6 == lastProcessed  \in [Server -> AgPos]
AgT7 == lastSnapshot   \in [Server -> AgPos]
AgT8 == /\ acceptedEpoch \in [Server -> Nat]
        /\ currentEpoch  \in [Server -> Nat]
        /\ tempMaxEpoch  \in [Server -> Nat]
AgT9  == state      \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
AgT10 == zabState   \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
AgT11 == /\ learners   \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
         /\ forwarding \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
AgT12 == /\ connecting \in [Server -> SUBSET AgConn]
         /\ electing   \in [Server -> SUBSET AgElec]

AgK1  == \A s \in Server : Len(initialHistory[s]) <= Len(history[s])
AgK2  == \A s \in Server : lastCommitted[s].index <= Len(history[s])
AgK3  == \A s \in Server : lastProcessed[s].index <= Len(history[s])
AgK4  == \A s \in Server : lastSnapshot[s].index <= lastCommitted[s].index
AgK5  == \A s \in Server : currentEpoch[s] <= acceptedEpoch[s]
AgK6  == \A s \in Server : AgSrt(history[s]) /\ (IsFollower(s) => AgSrt(AgCat(s)))
AgK7  == \A s \in Server : \A k \in 1..Len(AgCat(s)) : AgCat(s)[k].zxid[1] <= acceptedEpoch[s]
AgK8  == \A i, j \in Server : \A k \in 1..Len(msgs[j][i]) :
            msgs[j][i][k].mtype = PROPOSAL => msgs[j][i][k].mzxid[1] <= acceptedEpoch[i]
AgK9  == \A i, j \in Server : \A k \in 1..Len(msgs[j][i]) :
            msgs[j][i][k].mtype = SNAP =>
               \A n \in 1..Len(msgs[j][i][k].msnapshot) :
                    msgs[j][i][k].msnapshot[n].zxid[1] <= acceptedEpoch[i]
AgK10 == \A i, j \in Server : \A k \in 1..Len(msgs[i][j]) :
            msgs[i][j][k].mtype = LEADERINFO => msgs[i][j][k].mzxid[1] = acceptedEpoch[i]
AgK11 == \A i, j \in Server : AgHas(j, i, ACKEPOCH) => acceptedEpoch[j] >= acceptedEpoch[i]
AgK12 == \A i, j \in Server : (IsLeader(i) /\ \E e \in electing[i] : e.sid = j)
                                 => acceptedEpoch[j] >= acceptedEpoch[i]
AgK13 == \A i, j \in Server : (IsLeader(i) /\ j \in forwarding[i])
                                 => acceptedEpoch[j] >= acceptedEpoch[i]
AgK14 == \A i \in Server : ( \/ (\E j \in Server : AgHas(i, j, LEADERINFO))
                             \/ (\E j \in Server : AgHas(j, i, ACKEPOCH))
                             \/ (\E e \in electing[i] : e.sid # i)
                             \/ forwarding[i] # {} ) => AgQC(i)
AgK15 == \A i, j \in Server : AgHas(j, i, ACKEPOCH) => IsLeader(i)
AgK16 == \A i, j \in Server : AgHas(i, j, LEADERINFO) => IsLeader(i) /\ j \in learners[i]
AgK17 == \A i, j \in Server : AgHas(j, i, SNAP) => packetsSync[i].notCommitted = << >>
AgK18 == \A s \in Server : packetsSync[s].committed # << >>
             => \E idx \in 1..Len(AgCat(s)) :
                    TxnZxidEqual(AgCat(s)[idx], packetsSync[s].committed[Len(packetsSync[s].committed)])
AgK19 == \A s \in Server : msgs[s][s] = << >>
AgT13 == connectInfo \in [Server -> AgCInfo]
AgW1  == \A i, j \in Server : AgHasIn(i, j, AgL2F)
             => (IsLeader(i) /\ j \in learners[i] /\ i # j)
AgW2  == \A i, j \in Server : AgHasIn(i, j, AgF2L)
             => (IsFollower(i) /\ connectInfo[i].sid = j /\ i \in learners[j] /\ i # j)
AgW3  == \A i, j \in Server :
             (IsLeader(i) /\ \E e \in electing[i] : e.sid = j /\ ~ZxidEqual(e.peerLastZxid, <<-1,-1>>))
                => msgs[i][j] = << >>
AgW4  == \A i \in Server : forwarding[i] \subseteq learners[i]
AgW5  == \A i, j \in Server : AgHas(i, j, LEADERINFO) => Len(msgs[i][j]) = 1
AgW6  == \A i, j \in Server : AgHas(j, i, ACKEPOCH) => (Len(msgs[j][i]) = 1 /\ msgs[i][j] = << >>)
AgW7  == \A i, j \in Server : AgHasIn(j, i, {DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP})
             => (packetsSync[i].notCommitted = << >> /\ packetsSync[i].committed = << >>)
AgW8  == \A i, j \in Server : \A b \in 1..Len(msgs[i][j]) :
             msgs[i][j][b].mtype \in {DIFF, TRUNC, SNAP} => b = 1
AgW10 == \A i, j \in Server : AgHasIn(j, i, AgL2F) => connectInfo[i].sid = j
AgW11 == \A s \in Server : (IsFollower(s) /\ zabState[s] = SYNCHRONIZATION
                              /\ packetsSync[s].committed # << >>)
             => WriteToTxnLog(s)
AgW12 == \A s \in Server : (IsFollower(s) /\ zabState[s] = DISCOVERY)
             => (packetsSync[s].committed = << >> /\ packetsSync[s].notCommitted = << >>)
AgW13 == \A s \in Server : (IsFollower(s) /\ zabState[s] \in {DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION}
                            /\ ~WriteToTxnLog(s))
             => \/ Len(initialHistory[s]) = Len(history[s])
                \/ lastCommitted[s].index >= Len(history[s])
AgW14 == \A i \in Server : \A e \in electing[i] :
             e.sid = i => ZxidEqual(e.peerLastZxid, <<-1,-1>>)
AgK20 == \A s \in Server : IsLeader(s) => tempMaxEpoch[s] >= acceptedEpoch[s]
AgW15 == \A s \in Server : (IsFollower(s) /\ zabState[s] = BROADCAST)
             => packetsSync[s].notCommitted = << >>
AgW18 == \A s \in Server : (IsLeader(s) /\ zabState[s] \in {SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST})
             => currentEpoch[s] = acceptedEpoch[s]

AgInv == /\ AgT1 /\ AgT2 /\ AgT3 /\ AgT4 /\ AgT5 /\ AgT6 /\ AgT7 /\ AgT8
         /\ AgT9 /\ AgT10 /\ AgT11 /\ AgT12
         /\ AgK1  /\ AgK2  /\ AgK3  /\ AgK4  /\ AgK5  /\ AgK6  /\ AgK7
         /\ AgK8  /\ AgK9  /\ AgK10 /\ AgK11 /\ AgK12 /\ AgK13 /\ AgK14
         /\ AgK15 /\ AgK16 /\ AgK17 /\ AgK18 /\ AgK19 /\ AgT13
         /\ AgW1 /\ AgW2 /\ AgW3 /\ AgW4 /\ AgW5 /\ AgW6 /\ AgW7
         /\ AgW8 /\ AgW10 /\ AgW11 /\ AgW12 /\ AgW13 /\ AgW14 /\ AgK20
         /\ AgW15 /\ AgW18

AgDomOK == /\ DOMAIN msgs = Server
           /\ \A x \in Server : DOMAIN msgs[x] = Server
           /\ DOMAIN history = Server
           /\ DOMAIN packetsSync = Server
           /\ DOMAIN initialHistory = Server
           /\ DOMAIN lastCommitted = Server
           /\ DOMAIN lastProcessed = Server
           /\ DOMAIN lastSnapshot = Server
           /\ DOMAIN acceptedEpoch = Server
           /\ DOMAIN currentEpoch = Server
           /\ DOMAIN tempMaxEpoch = Server
           /\ DOMAIN state = Server
           /\ DOMAIN zabState = Server
           /\ DOMAIN learners = Server
           /\ DOMAIN forwarding = Server
           /\ DOMAIN connecting = Server
           /\ DOMAIN electing = Server
           /\ DOMAIN connectInfo = Server
           /\ \A s \in Server : DOMAIN packetsSync[s] = {"notCommitted", "committed"}
           /\ \A s \in Server : DOMAIN lastCommitted[s] = {"index", "zxid"}
           /\ \A s \in Server : DOMAIN lastProcessed[s] = {"index", "zxid"}
           /\ \A s \in Server : DOMAIN lastSnapshot[s] = {"index", "zxid"}
           /\ \A s \in Server : DOMAIN connectInfo[s] = {"sid", "syncMode", "nlRcv"}

LEMMA AgDom == AgInv => AgDomOK
  BY DEF AgInv, AgDomOK, AgT1, AgT2, AgT3, AgT4, AgT5, AgT6, AgT7, AgT8, AgT9,
         AgT10, AgT11, AgT12, AgT13, AgSyncS, AgSyncSIn, AgPos, AgCInfo

(* ============ COMMIT-in-sync needs a pending packet ============ *)

LEMMA AgCISNE ==
  ASSUME AgInv, NEW i \in Server,
         IsFollower(i), zabState[i] = SYNCHRONIZATION,
         ~WriteToTxnLog(i),
         LastCommitted(i).index + 1 <= LastQueued(i).index
  PROVE  packetsSync[i].notCommitted # << >>
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME packetsSync[i].notCommitted = << >> PROVE FALSE
  OBVIOUS
<1>a. history[i] \in Seq(AgOkTxn) /\ Len(history[i]) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP DEF AgInv, AgT1
<1>b. Len(packetsSync[i].notCommitted) = 0
  BY AgEmptyP
<1>c. ~IsLeader(i)
  BY DEF IsFollower, IsLeader, FOLLOWING, LEADING
<1>d. zabState[i] # BROADCAST
  BY DEF SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST
<1>1. packetsSync[i].committed = << >>
  BY DEF AgInv, AgW11

LEMMA AgInvIntegrity == AgInv => Integrity
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME AgInv, NEW i \in Server,
                    IsFollower(i), lastCommitted[i].index > 0
    PROVE  \A idx \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
              \E proposal \in proposalMsgsLog :
                 TxnEqual(history[i][idx],
                          [ zxid |-> proposal.zxid, value |-> proposal.data ])
  BY DEF Integrity
<1>1. history[i] \in Seq(AgOkTxn)
  BY DEF AgInv, AgT1
<1>2. lastCommitted[i].index <= Len(history[i])
  BY DEF AgInv, AgK2
<1>3. \A idx \in 1..Len(history[i]) : history[i][idx] \in AgOkTxn
  BY <1>1, AgLenP
<1>2b. lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat /\ Len(history[i]) \in Nat
  BY <1>1, AgLenP DEF AgInv, AgT5, AgPos
<1>4. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW idx \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
      PROVE  \E proposal \in proposalMsgsLog :
                TxnEqual(history[i][idx], [ zxid |-> proposal.zxid, value |-> proposal.data ])
  OBVIOUS
<1>5. idx \in 1..Len(history[i])
  BY <1>2, <1>2b
<1>6. history[i][idx] \in AgOkTxn
  BY <1>5, <1>3
<1>7. \E p \in proposalMsgsLog : /\ history[i][idx].zxid[1] = p.zxid[1]
                                 /\ history[i][idx].zxid[2] = p.zxid[2]
                                 /\ history[i][idx].value   = p.data
  BY <1>6 DEF AgOkTxn, AgTxnOkIn, AgInL
<1>8. QED
  BY <1>7 DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AgInvGPO == AgInv => GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME AgInv, NEW i \in Server, lastCommitted[i].index >= 2,
                    NEW idx1 \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
                    NEW idx2 \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
                    EpochPrecedeInTxn(history[i][idx1], history[i][idx2])
    PROVE  idx1 < idx2
  BY DEF GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>1. history[i] \in Seq(AgOkTxn) /\ Len(history[i]) \in Nat
  BY AgLenP DEF AgInv, AgT1
<1>2. lastCommitted[i].index <= Len(history[i]) /\ lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat
  BY DEF AgInv, AgK2, AgT5, AgPos
<1>3. AgSrt(history[i])
  BY DEF AgInv, AgK6
<1>4. idx1 \in 1..Len(history[i]) /\ idx2 \in 1..Len(history[i])
  BY <1>2, <1>1
<1>5. \A k \in 1..Len(history[i]) : history[i][k].zxid \in AgZxS
  BY <1>1, AgLenP DEF AgOkTxn, AgTxnOkIn, AgTxnS
<1>6. idx1 \in Nat /\ idx2 \in Nat
  BY <1>2
<1>7. history[i][idx1].zxid \in AgZxS /\ history[i][idx2].zxid \in AgZxS
  BY <1>4, <1>5
<1>8. history[i][idx1].zxid[1] < history[i][idx2].zxid[1]
  BY DEF EpochPrecedeInTxn
<1>9. SUFFICES ASSUME ~(idx1 < idx2) PROVE FALSE
  BY <1>6
<1>10. CASE idx1 = idx2
  BY <1>10, <1>8, <1>7 DEF AgZxS
<1>11. CASE idx2 < idx1
  <2>1. ZxidCompare(history[i][idx1].zxid, history[i][idx2].zxid)
    BY <1>11, <1>4, <1>3 DEF AgSrt
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, <1>8, <1>7 DEF ZxidCompare, AgZxS
<1>12. QED
  BY <1>6, <1>9, <1>10, <1>11
